text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} is out shopping with Hatsune.
text_block_list.orig_text: ハツネと買い物に来た{0}。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I wanna kind of change up my room. Maybe make it a bit
cuter, y'know? So I'd like to find something cute to put in
there, but... I'm just not sure what.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の部屋、
模様替えして、
もうちょっと可愛くしたいんだー
カワイイ置き物とかあるといいんだけど……
どういうのがいいか迷っちゃって。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
That's why I invited you out with me today.
To hear your thoughts!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんの意見も聞かせてほしくて、
呼んじゃった。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: So without further ado, let's get—
text_block_list.orig_text: というわけで、さっそくお買い物に──

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Aagh! That's bright! This is just like before, isn't it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ、
まぶしい……！
これって、
この前の……！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh...? I'm so sleepy all of a... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれ……？
また眠くなって……
スヤスヤ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Boy, the zoo sure was fun!
Hey, let's go check out the gift shop!
text_block_list.orig_text:
動物園、楽しかったね～
ねぇねぇ、
お土産も見ていこうよー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I wanna pick up a present for Shiorin while we're here.
What should I get her?
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかくだから、
しおりんにプレゼント買ってあげたいなー♪
どれにしよー？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this little panda plushie might be good! I think cute things
like this are right up her alley!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
このパンダのぬいぐるみ、
いいかも！
こういうカワイイのは、
しおりんによく似合うよねー

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-you think they suit me too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
わ、
私にも似合うって……！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat? Get real! If there's anything that suits me here,
it's... this tiger here! Roooar!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええー、
そんなことないよー
私に似合うのは……
こっちのトラとか！　
ガオー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Rawr! Rawr! I'm gonna eat you, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ガオー、
ガオー！
{0}くんを食べちゃうぞー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean you wouldn't taste that good?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なに？　
キミはおいしくない……？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Really? I think you look pretty tasty, myself.
You're bigger than me, so you'd definitely be more filling!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう？　
おいしそうだけどなー
私よりおっきいから、
食べごたえもありそうだし～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention, you're super funny, and nice, and forthright,
and handsome, and generous...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
とっても優しいし、
おもしろいし、
まじめだし、
カッコいいし、
親切だし……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Wha-huh? That's got nothing to do with the flavor, has it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
あれ？
おいしそうなのと、
関係ないかも……？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Yeah, geez. What am I saying?
choice_data_list: You can eat me if you'd like.
You're not... really gonna eat me, are you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、あはは……
私、
なに言ってるんだろうね？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Why would you let me?! More importantly, I-I'm not gonna eat
you for real, you weirdo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで受け入れてるの！？
というか……
ほ、本当に食べたりしないよー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: O-obviously not! Come on, do I [i]look[/i] like I'm gonna eat you?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、当たり前だよー！
私のこと、なんだと思ってるの！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Man, you really rattled me with all that crazy talk...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もー、
変なこと言うから、
ビックリしちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're gonna buy this for me to make up for it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？
お詫びに、
このトラさん買ってくれるの？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Thank you so much! Well, I think you deserve
a thank-you for that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんと！？　
ありがとー！
じゃあ、私にもお礼させて。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Homph!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……カプッ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Heehee. J-just a little nibble. O-on your cheek. That's all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ……
た、
食べちゃった。
ほ、
ほっぺただけど……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Aaand scene. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お疲れさまでした～♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Wow, Hatsune sure is forward. I'm honestly shocked.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハツネって、けっこう大胆なのね……
ビックリしたわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: And like, homph?! [i]HOMPH?![/i] Could she be any cuter?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
カプッてなによ！　
カプッて！？
可愛すぎるんじゃない！？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, it looks like you're just as friendly \"here\" as you
are on the over \"there\". Just enjoy yourself for the time being.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とりあえず『あっち』の時みたいに、
『こっち』でも友好な関係を続けられてるみたいだし、
もうしばらくはその生活を楽しんでいなさい。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I'm probably going to need your help pretty soon,
but until then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたにはそのうち頑張ってもらうことになるだろうけど、
それまでは、
ね……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: I think that's enough for today. Bye-bye. See you next time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
今回はこのくらいにしておくわ。
ばいば～い、
またね♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*... Was I asleep again?
Oh, were you sleeping here too, {0}?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぁ……
また寝ちゃってた？
あ、
{0}くんも寝てたんだー

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You dreamt about a zoo? That's the same dream I had!
Talk about déjà vu, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
動物園の夢！？
それって、私も見てたよー
前にもこんなことあったよね？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's it! Totally changing the subject, but why don't we
put a stuffed animal in my room? I think that's just the cute
touch I need!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
そうだ！　
私の部屋の模様替えだけど、
ぬいぐるみを置くのはどうかな？
カワイイと思うんだよねー

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You'll buy one for me?! Score! Thank you!
Now, how should I repay you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
買ってくれるの！？　
やったー！　
ありがとー！
なにか、お礼をしないとね？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Wait... Th-that reminds me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？　
お、
お礼っていえば……？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Hey, uh... S-something other than that! I might've \"eaten\" you
in the dream, but it was just in the heat of the moment,
y'know? I was just so happy, I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
その……
ち、
違うんだよ！
夢の中で{0}くんを食べちゃったのは、
勢いというか……
あまりにうれしくて、
つい……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
*whimper* God, even if it was a dream,
why would I do something so crazy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うぅ……
夢の中とはいえ、
なんであんなことしちゃったんだろ……？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Just forget it! Forget all about it!
We had a dream here, but it's gone now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なし、
なーし！
夢のことは忘れてーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Saying this, Hatsune fled the scene in her embarrassment.
text_block_list.orig_text:
恥ずかしさのあまり、
その場から逃げ出すハツネであった。
